title: Seafood Paella
summary: A classic Spanish rice dish with prawns, mussels and squid, cooked until the rice is savoury and lightly toasted and the seafood is just tender. Bright, smoky and perfect for a relaxed dinner.

ingredients.name: squid, cleaned and sliced into rings

steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide paella pan or large frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and red pepper and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the tomato and paprika. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the mixture looks thick and jammy.
Add the squid and cook for 2 minutes so it turns opaque. Stir in the rice, coating it well in the tomato mixture.
Pour in the hot stock, add the salt and black pepper, and spread the rice out evenly. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cook uncovered for about 15 minutes without stirring.

Arrange the prawns and mussels over the top, pressing the mussels hinge-side down if possible. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes more, until the mussels open, the prawns are pink, and the rice is tender with a little bite. Discard any mussels that do not open.
Remove from the heat and rest for 5 minutes. Scatter over the parsley and serve with lemon wedges.
